image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a vintage typewriter keyboard. The focus is on the bottom row of keys, specifically highlighting the elongated space bar which is cream-colored and rectangular. Above it are rows of round, black typewriter keys with white characters. The background shows the metallic carriage and paper bail of the typewriter in soft focus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated rectangular key spanning the full width of the bottom keyboard row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows a long, rectangular key at the bottom center that spans the width of the main typing area, consistent with a space bar.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visually, the space bar is significantly longer than the adjacent circular keys. While 'ten times' is an approximation for round vs rectangular geometry, the proportional dominance is accurate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is flat or slightly concave.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top surface of the space bar appears flat with rounded edges, typical of vintage typewriter design.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Underside connects to a long stabilizer bar mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside and internal mechanical linkage (stabilizer bar) are completely occluded by the keycap itself and the camera angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label is typically blank with no printed character.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible top surface of the space bar is plain cream-colored plastic with no text or symbols.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Positioned centrally between modifier keys on the bottom row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is centered horizontally relative to the keyboard layout shown.
The material appears to be hard plastic with a low-gloss, matte finish, consistent with vintage typewriters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The key is cream/off-white, matching the body of the typewriter and contrasting with the black keys, fitting the 'match color scheme' criteria.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly integrated into a typewriter keyboard assembly.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal components in the background have a slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth texture lacking the fine micro-scratches or dust expected on a vintage mechanical device. This is a common AI smoothing artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Key stems/linkages under the front row
artifact_observations.reasoning: The green/teal stems supporting the front-most keys appear to merge indistinctly into the base plate without clear mechanical pivots or distinct separation. They look like melted plastic rather than distinct mechanical parts.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the space bar
artifact_observations.reasoning: The right end of the space bar seems to curve upward slightly more than perspective would dictate, potentially indicating minor geometric warping.
